---
name: 功能建议 / Feature Request
about: 提出新功能或改进建议 / Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[enhancement]"
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
type: Feature

---

🎯 功能概述 / Feature Summary

请简要描述你希望新增或改进的功能。

Briefly describe the feature or improvement you would like to see.

🔍 需求背景 / Problem or Motivation

目前遇到了什么问题？现有功能有哪些不足？为什么需要这项改进？

What problem are you trying to solve? What limitations exist in the current functionality?

✨ 期望实现 / Proposed Solution

请描述你希望功能如何工作，以及预期达到的效果。

Describe how you would like the feature to work and what you expect it to achieve.

🔄 替代方案 / Alternatives Considered

是否尝试过其他解决方法？如果有，请简要说明。

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? If so, please describe them.

📸 参考资料 / References

如有相关截图、界面草图、示例或参考链接，可以在此提供。

You may attach screenshots, mockups, examples, or relevant links.

📝 补充说明 / Additional Context

其他有助于理解或评估该建议的信息。

Add any other context that may help us evaluate your suggestion.

🙏 感谢你的支持与贡献！/ Thank you for your support and contribution!

我们会根据功能价值、技术可行性、项目定位及维护成本综合评估建议。提交建议不代表该功能一定会被实现。

Suggestions will be evaluated based on their value, technical feasibility, project scope, and maintenance cost. Submission does not guarantee implementation.
